description:
Phase 5 brings the /prompts/ MCP surface up to the same operational
safety contract as the CLI surface after Phases 1-4: smoke runs for
paid or non-local target-scale executions, cost acknowledgment for
paid target-scale executions, platform-option gap notes, TPC-DS
subscale dsdgen warnings, result analysis, provenance capture, and
optional plan capture guidance.

The implementation deliberately uses existing MCP surfaces only. It
does not add new MCP tools, and it avoids inventing unsupported
run_benchmark arguments for platform options.

deferrals.reason: Requires MCP tool API work outside the landing prompt batch.
deferrals.summary: Add first-class MCP platform option arguments

deferrals.reason: Unit and render-smoke coverage prove prompt generation; live MCP integration is a separate surface.
deferrals.summary: MCP live-server integration tests for rendered prompts

preserves.behavior: Catalog MCP tool and prompt names are validated against benchbox/mcp/.
MCP prompt ordering remains list_available -> dependency check -> optional safety notes -> dry run -> live run -> summary/provenance.
MCP uses the same Phase 2-3 smoke, cost, and dsdgen predicates as CLI.

work_units.notes:
MCP tools are already non-interactive and capture output through
tool responses rather than shell tee logs. The prompt maps CLI
guardrails to MCP-native steps: run_benchmark smoke calls,
user-facing cost acknowledgment, analyze_results for compare
result files, system_profile for provenance, and get_query_plan
after optional capture_plans=true runs.

Reuses the shared needsSmokeStep and needsCostAcknowledgment
predicates so MCP and CLI stay aligned on cost_class, deployment,
and scale thresholds.
work_units.summary: Extend buildMcpPrompt with smoke and cost-acknowledgment steps

work_units.notes:
TPC-DS dsdgen warnings mirror the CLI text. Platform-option hints
render as an explicit MCP surface gap because run_benchmark does
not expose a platform option argument; the prompt tells users to
configure values via BenchBox config/env or switch to CLI.
work_units.summary: Render platform-option hints and dsdgen warnings in MCP prompts

work_units.notes:
Compare prompts call analyze_results with file1/file2 from live
mcp_metadata.result_file responses. Single-run prompts summarize
the run_benchmark payload and optionally call aggregate analysis.
Provenance calls system_profile, whose payload includes BenchBox
version and system fields. Optional plan capture uses
capture_plans=true plus get_query_plan.
work_units.summary: Use real MCP analysis, provenance, and plan tools

work_units.notes:
Added validator coverage for analysis_tool, system_profile_tool,
and plan_tool; static prompt tests for real-tool wording and the
platform-option gap; generated catalog parity assertions; and
render smoke coverage for paid/local/compare MCP prompts.
